entries.title: Impress 3D Steps 原完整空间镜头
adaptations: Expose steps[i].title/subtitle only; original geometry, colors, easing and camera are unchanged.

entries.title: Terminal 3D 原完整命令叙事镜头
adaptations: Expose panel copy; pose, focus, typewriter timing and original 3D camera remain unchanged.
Neutral defaults replace fabricated example logs and addresses.

entries.title: Ink Press 原10镜头完整宣传片模板

Asset resolver adds sources/video-shotcraft/ink-press prefix, overrideable with assetBase.
Expose title/caption/scene copy props; original 10-shot timeline, camera keys, palette and timing retained.

entries.title: Ink Press 原合影组装收尾镜头
adaptations: Original SceneOutroLive wrapped in its VisualThemeProvider.
Neutral wordmark/tagline; photographic page textures still need target-product replacement.
